node.statement: Equation (1.7) gives rho_fac<=rho_DeltaUpsilon. Equation (1.5) gives rho_DeltaUpsilon<=rho_Upsilon. The definition of rho_Upsilon in (1.5) includes rho_Upsilon' among its minimum entries, so rho_Upsilon<=rho_Upsilon'. Thus rho_fac<=rho_DeltaUpsilon<=rho_Upsilon<=rho_Upsilon'.
